annotations.title: Draw a shirt from a photo or a picture

description: Turns an image into a t-shirt design in the shop’s dot-drawing style: a person’s photo, or a picture an AI assistant made in this conversation (“put this on a t-shirt”). Takes the image as a file (`photo`) or as an https link (`photo_url`). Makes three pictures; returns the first as soon as it is ready, with the drawing’s id.

made_by_assistant.description: true when the image was made by an AI assistant rather than being a photo.

photo.description: The image, as a file from this conversation.

photo_url.description: The image, as an https link.

name: draw_from_photo
